key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Erect branching herb, often somewhat taller/coarser than C. basalis.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Opposite below, dissected into many narrow threadlike segments.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Showy yellow rays with broad maroon to reddish-brown bases; disks dark.

key_traits.label: Phyllaries
key_traits.text: Outer bracts often spreading beneath a broader inner involucre.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: Annual, usually branched with opposite lower leaves divided into very narrow linear/threadlike segments.; Yellow rays frequently have dark reddish-brown basal patches, but patch extent varies and cannot alone distinguish the species.; Inspect mature head underside: outer involucral bracts and inner bracts, plus flat cypselae, to distinguish from similar annual Coreopsis.; Compare Coreopsis basalis: often broader leaf segments and differing head/fruit characters; use paired measured leaves and phyllary/fruit photos rather than petal coloration alone.
